_readme: Projects added by hand for the forks/families work (prefill/assemble.mjs reads this). Each needs a license read from its own files (licenseSource) and one or more groups.

newGroups.name: Caches & key-value stores
newGroups.job: Keeping data an app needs quickly in memory

newGroups.name: Infrastructure as code
newGroups.job: Setting up servers and cloud services from files

projects.name: Chromium
projects.summary: Chromium is the open-source web browser project that Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Brave and many other browsers are built from. It is for people who want a Chrome-like browser made entirely from open code.

groups.note: The open code behind Chrome; ready-made downloads mostly come from Linux distributions or other makers

projects.name: Floorp
projects.summary: Floorp is a web browser built from Firefox's code, made in Japan, with extra ways to arrange and customize its look and layout. It is for people who like Firefox but want more control over how it looks.

projects.name: Mullvad Browser
projects.summary: Mullvad Browser is a privacy-focused web browser made by Mullvad VPN together with the Tor Project. It makes its users look alike to websites so they are harder to track, and it works without the Tor network. It is for people who want strong tracking protection.

groups.note: Built to be used with a VPN; no sync or extras

projects.name: KeePassX
projects.summary: KeePassX is a password manager that keeps your logins in one locked file on your own computer. Its developers announced in December 2021 that it is no longer developed; KeePassXC continues it. It is listed so people who still have it can find its successor.

groups.note: No longer developed; KeePassXC continues it

projects.name: Apache OpenOffice
projects.summary: Apache OpenOffice is a free office suite with a word processor, spreadsheet and presentation program. It is for people who want a free alternative to Microsoft Office. It is one of two continuations of the older OpenOffice.org; LibreOffice is the other.

projects.name: VSCodium
projects.summary: VSCodium is a ready-to-install version of the code editor behind Microsoft's Visual Studio Code, built without Microsoft's branding, tracking and license terms. It is for programmers who want VS Code's editor from fully open-source downloads.

groups.note: Uses the Open VSX extension store, so some Microsoft-made extensions are not available

projects.name: Valkey
projects.summary: Valkey is a fast in-memory database that websites and apps use to keep data they need quickly, such as logged-in sessions or saved pages. It continues the last open-licensed version of Redis and is run by the Linux Foundation. It is for developers and server administrators.

projects.name: Redis
projects.summary: Redis is a fast in-memory database that websites and apps use to keep data they need quickly, such as logged-in sessions or saved pages. It is for developers and server administrators.

groups.note: Open source again from version 8 (AGPL option); versions 7.4 to 7.x were source-available only

projects.name: OpenTofu
projects.summary: OpenTofu lets you describe servers and cloud services in files, then creates and updates them automatically. It is a Linux Foundation project that continues Terraform under an open-source license. It is for developers and system administrators.
